Text.text: A contract is a long-term agreement with a vendor for the supply of materials or the performance of services.

StandardListItem.title: Quantity Contract (MK)
StandardListItem.description: Total quantity of materials to be ordered.

StandardListItem.title: Value Contract (WK)
StandardListItem.description: Total value of materials/services to be ordered.

Text.text: A scheduling agreement involves a fixed delivery schedule with specific quantities and dates.
Release Order: Not required (Delivery schedules are used instead).
